steps.sql: CREATE FUNCTION get_strictest_mutability(entity_id bigint, key text) RETURNS text AS $$ BEGIN RETURN (SELECT mutability_class FROM entity_facts WHERE entity_id = $1 AND key = $2); END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_current_stateful_facts AS SELECT mutability_class FROM entity_facts;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_fact_grades AS SELECT get_strictest_mutability(entity_id, key) AS strictest FROM entity_facts;
ALTER TABLE entity_facts ADD COLUMN mutability_class mutability_class_enum DEFAULT 'slow_changing'::mutability_class_enum NOT NULL;
